race.description: Spring Carnival On Sale Now Plate (C3)
race.comment: ESHA (6) got the job done over this track and trip two back before just missing the frame in Saturday metro grade at the latest outing. Rock-hard fit now fourth-up from the break and should be right there when the whips are cracking. IMPERIAL FORCE (1) also hails from a handy family (full to G3 winner Sprightly Lass) and will find this easier than recent Sydney efforts. Watch for a spike in form. QUEIN STEP (10) is a first-up winner who shouldn't be slept on. THE POOL BOY (3) may enjoy the drop back in distance and should be hitting peak fitness third up.
